notes: Shelly tiles are filed under the device's own identity instead of its IP address. Every per-tile setting - name, room, size, position in the order - used to hang off the address, so each DHCP move silently orphaned the lot: the kitchen unit went .77 to .52 to .51, and the bedroom roller .56 to .80 when the hardware was replaced, each time scattering the layout. The firmware's device id survives both a new lease and a replacement unit. Settings > Layout also gains Restore from server, which pulls the stored arrangement back onto a panel whose own layout has gone wrong - the startup reconcile only helps a panel that has no layout at all. And the one-time size overrides from v1.1.31 are gone; they were outliving their purpose and quietly overriding sizes chosen since.
